I was thinking how we click on a link here, it expands the picture, .gif, or WebM or whatever like RES. Now what if we implemented that practice to the comments. Think of a reasonably sized display window would pop-up if you clicked a different button. The comment display window would have its own scroll bars on each side so you could view the comments within the window instead of opening a whole other page. Now in order to actually participate and upvoat/downvoat you would have to open a new window.

The reason for this, is that in the case of a controversial, a broken link, or things of that nature, it would prevent people from making quick decisions without thinking or seeing any other comments. Hyperlinks would be able to be opened and text could be copied, but any actual involvement would require you to do more. That way we would have quick access to mirrors(which are usually voted to the top), and gives us more "Ease of Use" for the site. I'm sure there's more but I'm leaving soon. I'd love to keep pitching the idea, so any questions or concerns I'd be more than happy to discuss this.
